environment.description: ECS Fargate service in a private subnet, fronted by an internal ALB. The ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL has three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'internal-query-hygiene' with a single rule that uses a RegexPatternSet matching the pattern '[;\-]{2}|UNION\s+SELECT|DROP\s+TABLE|INTO\s+OUTFILE|LOAD_FILE|BENCHMARK\s*\(' applied to SingleQueryArgument on all query string keys with BLOCK action and priority 0, (3) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action. Additionally, the RDS database user is configured with: GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_user; (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE). The Web ACL default action is ALLOW.

config.rds_user_grants: GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_user;
